score.reason: The launch of Apple's $2,000 foldable iPhone amidst strong demand signals exceptionally high commercial intent. Early adopters of such a premium, novel device are actively seeking to maximize their investment, understand its unique features, and protect it. While the tech review space is competitive, there's significant room for highly specialized information products, guides, and masterclasses that address specific user pain points (e.g., 'messy, expensive good time' implies a learning curve) and optimization needs. The high price point means users are willing to pay for solutions that enhance their experience and safeguard their investment. This topic is highly productizable into digital guides or newsletters, catering to a niche of affluent early adopters eager for curated content.

sales.search_strategy: High-Net-Worth (HNW) Tech Enthusiasts/Early Adopters can be found in premium tech forums (e.g., MacRumors, XDA-Developers discussing high-end devices), luxury lifestyle online communities, Subreddits like r/apple, r/iPhone, r/foldables (monitoring early adopter discussions), and by identifying public profiles on platforms like X (Twitter) or Instagram discussing their pre-orders or high-end gadget purchases. Tech Reviewers & Influencers are prominent on YouTube (tech review channels), popular tech blogs (e.g., The Verge, CNET, Engadget), LinkedIn (searching 'tech journalist', 'gadget reviewer', 'tech content creator'), and X (Twitter) (following tech journalists and prominent tech enthusiasts). Premium Tech Support & Concierge Services can be identified via LinkedIn (searching 'IT concierge', 'premium tech support', 'luxury tech services', 'white glove tech'), local business directories targeting high-end services, and by researching Apple authorized service providers that offer premium or concierge tiers.
